description: Stop bleeding, set bones, treat infection. Your hands remember the ER.
name: Triage
synergyHints: Adrenaline Control: stabilize then fight on

description: Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
name: Steady Hands

description: Read sign: tracks, scat, browse lines. You know what's been here and how long ago.
name: Game Sense
synergyHints: Patient Aim: find it, then drop it clean

description: One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
name: Patient Aim

description: Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
name: Field Dressing
synergyHints: Preservation Instinct: harvest, then keep it

description: You think in shelf life. Smoking, drying, salting — food that lasts is food that saves.
name: Preservation Instinct

description: Tell dandelion from disaster at a glance. The woods start talking.
name: Forage Identification

description: Your gut handles what it shouldn't. A useful lie your body tells itself.
name: Iron Stomach

description: Move through woods like weather. Less noise, fewer surprises.
name: Soft Step

description: Someone taught you this over a long winter. Knowledge is the only inheritance.
name: Taught Hands

description: The System noticed you noticing patterns. It approves, in its way.
name: Pattern Recognition

description: Burn bright, pay later. Once per expedition, act twice.
name: Adrenaline Control
Green Thumb
description: Foraging yields +50%. You know where to look.
flavor: PLANTS LIKE YOU! We asked them!

name: Tracker
description: Hunting success +30%. You read the ground.
flavor: You see the footprints! We only see feet!

name: Diplomat
description: Trust builds 2x faster. People open up to you.
flavor: You make the sad faces go away! Teach us?

name: Camp Cook
description: Cooking uses half the water. +10% kcal.
flavor: The food sings! We hear it! Do you hear it?

name: Generous Heart
description: Donating gives 2x trust.
flavor: Sharing! We love sharing! Have our moon!

name: Scrounger
description: Ruin looting finds +1 item.
flavor: You find the shiny things in the broken places!

name: Squirrel Friend
description: Squirrels sometimes leave you nuts. (Random gifts.)
flavor: The tiny tree-people like you! They pay rent in acorns!

name: Rain Dancer
description: When it rains, +1L water free. (You dance. It works.)
flavor: You wiggle and the sky cries! We tried wiggling! Nothing happened!

name: Loud Chewer
description: Eating is 2x louder (monsters hear you). But +5 morale.
flavor: CRONCH CRONCH! We love the cronch! The monsters love it too! Oops!

name: Hoarder
description: +10kg carry, but villagers trust you 20% less. (They notice.)
flavor: You keep the things! ALL the things! We... are concerned! But impressed!

name: Light Fingers
description: Steal from pantry without trust loss (50%). If caught, -20 trust.
flavor: The food disappears! Magic! (It's not magic. We saw you.)

name: Photosynthesis
description: Gain 100 kcal/hour in sunlight. (You're becoming a plant.)
flavor: YOU EAT THE SUN! We eat... we don't eat! But WOW!

name: Second Wind
description: Once per day, when you'd die, you don't. (1 HP, 500 kcal.)
flavor: You were almost gone! Then you WEREN'T! How?! We want to know!

name: Lucky Rock
description: You have a lucky rock. (+1% to everything. It's the thought that counts.)
flavor: The rock! It is lucky! We can feel the luck! (We can't. But you can!)

name: Bird Whisperer
description: Birds land on you sometimes. (No effect. But birds.)
flavor: The sky-flappers trust you! We are jealous!
